title: Dimensions for couplings for oil and fuel reception for inland vessels
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the dimensions for 4 sizes of couplings for oil and fuel reception for inland vessels and port installations.
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions for couplings for oil and fuel reception for inland vessels

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
